legendsContent.title: Murder One
legendsContent.excerpt: Murder One, born Ronald Thomas, is a Houston rapper and member of the South Park Coalition. His catalog includes Rhythm for Thugs, Dirty Game and Hood Element with Wash-Off.
legendsContent.body:
## Introduction
Ronald Thomas, known professionally as Murder One, is a Houston rapper and member of the South Park Coalition. His owner-supplied biography identifies Houston, Texas as his origin and places his recording debut on K-Rino's 1993 album Stories from the Black Book.

## Early South Park Coalition appearance
The 1993 Stories from the Black Book track listing credits Murder One on War in South Park alongside A.C. Chill, Greek, Ganksta NIP, DBX, The Beholder and Point Blank. This early appearance documents his connection to K-Rino and the South Park Coalition recording circle.

## Solo career and Over Looked Records
Murder One began his solo career in 2003, founded Over Looked Records and released his debut solo album, Rhythm for Thugs. His second solo studio album, Dirty Game, followed in 2011 through Over Looked Records. Catalog credits also connect his work with SPC artists including K-Rino, Klondike Kat, Dope-E, PSK-13 and Ganxsta Nip.

## Wash-Off collaboration and later catalog
Hood Element, a collaboration with Wash-Off, was released in 2012. Apple Music lists the 12-song album with a May 2, 2012 release date. Catalog listings also document the later Hood Element Reloaded release in 2016, so this profile does not describe the 2012 album as his latest release.

## SPC Legends
Murder One is one of the twelve featured artist characters in SPC Legends: Spin the Mix. His approved character artwork represents his place in the game's celebration of Houston music and South Park Coalition culture.

## Source note
Primary biographical source: an owner-supplied Murder One biography received from Mr. CAP on November 27, 2026. Release dates, appearances and catalog details were cross-checked against the linked album and artist references.

legendsContent.title: Klondike Kat
legendsContent.excerpt: Klondike Kat is an original South Park Coalition artist, rapper and singer whose Houston catalog stretches from the 1993 Hustler EP to Diamond Dre.
legendsContent.body:
## Introduction
Klondike Kat is an original member of the South Park Coalition and a Houston artist whose work moves between rapping and singing. His owner-supplied biography describes a versatile vocal style that uses shifting accents and a persistent search for new beats and lyrics.

## Early musical journey
Klondike Kat began his rap journey in 1986 with encouragement from his mother and grandmother. At 13, he formed a singing group with friends and performed in school talent shows. He began writing original material in high school and battled artists from other Houston schools, a path that eventually brought him together with K-Rino.

## Discography
His first EP, Hustler, was released in 1993. The supplied biography also lists Mobbin' Music Melodies in 1996, Biography of a Made Man in 1999, Eating Off the Streets Vol. 1 in 2001, Eating Off the Streets Vol. 2 in 2003, Grand Theft Hustling in 2009 and Diamond Dre in 2019.

## Collaboration and performance
Klondike Kat's collaborators include K-Rino, Point Blank, Cl'Che and other South Park Coalition artists. His performance history includes appearances with DJ Screw, Ice-T, Lil Keke, Z-Ro and Trae tha Truth. He is also named among the featured artists on the SPC group album The Ties That Bind Us.

## Source note
This profile draws on an owner-supplied Klondike Kat biography received November 27, 2026 and the official Mr. CAP archive.

legendsContent.title: Mr. CAP
legendsContent.excerpt: Mr. CAP (Cornelius A. Pratt) is a Houston rapper, an Original Member of the South Park Coalition and the presenter of SPC Legends through 713MIXHOUSE.
legendsContent.body:
## Introduction
Mr. CAP, born Cornelius A. Pratt, is a Houston rapper, entrepreneur and creative technologist. An Original Member of the South Park Coalition, he presents SPC Legends through 713MIXHOUSE and is the starter Legend on every account board.

## Early life and South Park Coalition
Raised in Houston's South Park neighborhood, Mr. CAP grew up in a musical family and began performing at eight years old as an opening act for The Greer Brothers. At Jack Yates Senior High School, he formed The Raise Up Posse with Texas Tech and Ron-E. He joined the South Park Coalition in 1990 and became known for direct storytelling and a distinctive Southern perspective.

## Music and independent work
His debut solo album, 2 Tha Grave, arrived in 2011, followed by The Art of ISM in 2019. His catalog includes Cap International, Limitless featuring K-Rino, Unsolved Mysteries: The Single Pt. 1 with K-Rino, and work on the SPC group album The Ties That Bind Us. His collaborations extend across the South Park Coalition and the wider Houston rap community.

## Technology and entrepreneurship
Mr. CAP founded CAP Distributions to support digital music distribution. His official biography also documents his computer-network engineering education, computer science studies and work across music, publishing and digital platforms.

## Source note
This profile draws on owner-supplied biographies received November 27, 2026, the official Mr. CAP website and the linked press coverage.

legendsContent.title: K-Rino
legendsContent.excerpt: K-Rino is the founder of the South Park Coalition and a prolific Houston lyricist whose independent catalog spans more than 30 studio albums.
legendsContent.body:
## Introduction
Eric Kaiser, known professionally as K-Rino and often called The Wizard, is a Houston rapper, lyricist and founder of the South Park Coalition. His work is known for intricate wordplay, storytelling, social commentary and a longstanding commitment to independent music.

## Founding the South Park Coalition
K-Rino founded the South Park Coalition in 1987 to bring Houston rappers together around collaboration, support and creative independence. The collective grew from South Park into a lasting force in Houston hip-hop. Primary historical source: Mr. CAP, an Original Member of the South Park Coalition, confirmed the 1987 founding year from firsthand knowledge on November 27, 2026.

## Independent catalog
K-Rino's debut album, Stories from the Black Book, was released in 1993. His owner-supplied biography credits him with more than 30 studio albums, including Solitary Confinement, Time Traveler, The Blood Doctrine and the seven-disc The Big Seven project released in 2016. His catalog moves between personal narratives, social questions, philosophy and speculative concepts while retaining a focus on lyrical craft.

## Work with Mr. CAP and SPC
The Mr. CAP discography lists Limitless featuring K-Rino and Unsolved Mysteries: The Single Pt. 1 by Mr. CAP and K-Rino. K-Rino also appears on the SPC group album The Ties That Bind Us. Houston Press covered K-Rino, Point Blank and the SPC performing at Warehouse Live in September 2015.

## Source note
This profile draws on an owner-supplied K-Rino biography received November 27, 2026, the official Mr. CAP archive and the linked press coverage.

legendsContent.title: Point Blank
legendsContent.excerpt: OG Point Blank, known as The Bull, is a South Park Coalition artist and Wreckless Klan founder whose solo work and DJ Screw collaborations helped shape Houston rap.
legendsContent.body:
## Introduction
OG Point Blank, widely known as The Bull, is a Chicago-born rapper who moved to Houston during his teenage years and developed his voice in the South Park neighborhood. He is a South Park Coalition artist and a member of Wreckless Klan.

## South Park Coalition and Wreckless Klan
Point Blank joined the South Park Coalition in 1990, working alongside artists including K-Rino and Ganxsta Nip. Within that creative community, he built a reputation for gritty storytelling and a direct delivery, then helped form Wreckless Klan.

## Solo releases
His debut album, Prone to Bad Dreams, was released through Big Tyme Records in 1992. The supplied biography also lists Mad At The World in 1994, N Tha Do and Blowin' Up The Scene in 1996, Bad Newz Travels Fast in 1999, Just When You Thought It Was Safe in 2007, Pick Your Poison in 2010 and the Ganxstaz Only releases.

## DJ Screw and performance history
Point Blank's DJ Screw collaborations include Sentimental Value and As The World Turns Slow in 2002, followed by My Personal Screw Tape in 2003. His owner-supplied biography also documents performances with UGK, the Geto Boyz and DJ Screw, along with later international touring. Houston Press covered his 2014 appearance at Numbers and the SPC's 2015 Warehouse Live performance.

## Source note
This profile draws on two owner-supplied Point Blank biographies received November 27, 2026 and the linked press archive.
